item.title: Burn ban lifted in Caddo Parish
item.description: Effective Monday, Feb. 16, 2026, the burn ban in Caddo Parish has been lifted. Residents are now permitted to resume outdoor burning activities, but officials remind the public to continue exercising caution and to follow all local and state fire safety guidelines.
